result: Implement Milestone 1 and push directly to GitHub.
Confirmed package scaffold and planning documents existed before implementation.
Configured package metadata and added Verdict, VerificationCase, ExecutionResult and InspectionResult.
Added strict benchmark-case loading and validation.
Added deterministic subprocess execution with stdout, stderr, exit status, duration and timeout capture.
Added original/patched inspection flow and evidence persistence under artifacts/<case_id>/.
Added seed complete-fix, partial-fix and regression-introducing fixtures.
Added tests for case loading, command execution, timeout behavior and benchmark execution shape.
Independent clone/test attempt could not resolve github.com; no project failure was observed.
Original failed, patched passed, evidence files were persisted.
Close Milestone 1 only after local verification; preserve deterministic execution as the truth layer before adding LLM reasoning.
